description: This is a 3D model preview of a simple, modern staircase. It features a clean, minimalist design with four distinct steps. The steps are rectangular and appear to be of equal height and depth, creating a uniform ascent. The overall impression is one of functionality and simplicity, suitable for various architectural styles. The edges are sharp and well-defined, suggesting a precise construction. The model is rendered with soft lighting that creates subtle shadows, giving it a sense of depth and form.
